baseline_prompt:
def is_sorted(lst):
    '''
    Given a list of numbers, return whether or not they are sorted
    in an order. If list has more than 1 duplicate of the same
    number, return False. Assume no negative numbers and only integers.
    '''

candidates.question: Are duplicate values allowed at all, or must the list contain only unique numbers to be considered sorted?
candidates.answer: Yes, up to 1 duplicate of the same number is allowed (a number may appear at most twice); more than 2 occurrences of the same value causes False.
